CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetBaseTemplatePath

Returns the absolute file system path of the base template: the page named in the URL. Included files and custom tags get the same answer as the page that called them.

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetBaseTemplatePath()

Returns

The absolute path of the base template.

Usage

Compare GetCurrentTemplatePath, which returns the path of the file that contains the call. Combine it with GetDirectoryFromPath to find files that live next to the requested page.

GetTemplatePath is an older name for the same function.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Called from</TH><TH>GetCurrentTemplatePath()</TH><TH>GetBaseTemplatePath()</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>getbasetemplatepath.cfm (this page)</TD>
<TD>#GetFileFromPath(GetCurrentTemplatePath())#</TD>
<TD>#GetFileFromPath(GetBaseTemplatePath())#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
<CFINCLUDE TEMPLATE="sn_syswhere.cfm">
</TABLE>
<CFOUTPUT><P>Full path: #GetBaseTemplatePath()#</CFOUTPUT>
